family_sheet.summary: Scholar CCB helps schools manage staff capability: roles and competencies, tasks, talent records, HR operations and learning.
family_sheet.problem: Staff roles, skills, tasks, reviews and training sit in separate tools, so schools struggle to see who is ready for what.
family_sheet.benefit: Role needs, capability ratings, tasks, reviews and learning could become easier to connect, so development conversations could start from clearer information.

research.text: Capability Explorer designed from O*NET and SkillsFuture Singapore occupational reference data, per its source notes.

items.name: Organization Management
items.summary: One place for the school's organization profile, departments, staff directory, compliance duties, disciplinary records and role-wise screen access.
items.problem: Staff details, compliance deadlines and discipline records are often kept apart, so ownership is hard to see.
features: Department pages with employees, job roles and SOPs
Staff directory with filters, status switch and CSV export
Compliance register with calendar, overdue list and templates
Disciplinary records by department and employee
Role and permissions matrix for screen access
items.benefit: Staff, compliance and discipline records could become easier to find, and responsibilities easier to follow, in one place.
owner_to_confirm: Served by next_lms_erp (routes/organization_management.php and routes/api.php), not hp_erp; screens are ports of G2G screens.
Menu lists three report screens (Employee Directory, Compliance, Disciplinary) with no page in the front end; not shown.
Add New People sheet uses sample options and Import is disabled; not shown.
Department Policies and Rules tabs hold sample lists; not shown.
Saving a competency rating from the staff profile has a known failing call; not shown.
SOP drafting with AI needs an AI provider set up for the school; confirm before demo.
Menu spells 'Diciplinary' and route 'oragnization'; fix before showing.
Organization Profile fields read like a company form (registration, tax numbers, sister companies).

items.name: Task Management
items.summary: Staff tasks, projects, dependencies and deadlines in one workspace, with reports on delays and productivity and a full audit trail.
items.problem: When tasks live in chats and spreadsheets, owners, deadlines and delays are hard to follow.
features: My Tasks in list or board view
Link each task to the capability it builds
Dependency map, timeline and milestone views
Deadline extension requests with approve or reject
Productivity and delay reports with audit log export
items.benefit: Task ownership, deadlines and blockers could become easier to see, and staff work could connect more clearly to capability.
owner_to_confirm: Served by next_lms_erp (routes/task_management.php); a port of the G2G task module, not hp_erp.
Reports tab 'Learning Recommendations' calls a route missing in next_lms_erp; not shown.
Create Task 'generate with AI' sparkle calls a route not found in next_lms_erp; not shown.
Integration screen (outside message providers) carries a sample badge; not shown.
Capability link applies only to job-role catalogue tasks, not custom tasks.
Permissions Matrix is read-only; it and the reports need an elevated staff role.

items.name: Talent Management
items.summary: Hiring, onboarding, reviews, internal moves, exits, certifications and capability ratings for school staff, connected in one lifecycle view.
items.problem: Hiring, reviews, certifications and staff skills are tracked separately, so leaders lack a joined-up view of their people.
features: Hiring flow from job opening to offer
Onboarding journey with probation and confirmation
Goals, reviews and appraisals in review cycles
Rate staff on capability items from one to five
Development plans show gaps against role needs
items.benefit: Staff journeys from hiring to development could become easier to follow, with capability ratings and role needs visible side by side.
owner_to_confirm: Served by next_lms_erp (routes/talent_management.php, routes/competency_management.php); ports of the G2G talent module, not hp_erp.
Administration screen: only the Workflows tab works, other tabs say under construction; not shown.
Development & Career Paths: the Learning Assignments tab and its 'Assign Learning' buttons call missing routes; not shown, hide before demo.
Mobility & Succession mixes live data with fixed filter lists and fixed trend text; do not quote its figures.
Capability ratings need library items; a 8 Sep decision note found the rating table empty; check live data first.
Recruitment: saving a new job opening calls an outside webhook (ported as-is); job-text analysis result is not shown to users.
Performance Reviews has Compensation and Bonus tabs (money data); not shown.
Menu spells 'Onbording'; fix before showing.

items.name: HRIT Management
items.summary: Attendance, leave and payroll records for school staff, with approvals, configuration and reports in one HR operations area.
items.problem: Attendance registers, leave requests and payroll papers are handled separately, which can slow approvals and month-end checks.
features: Punch in and out with attendance KPIs
Leave requests with single and bulk approval
Leave types, holidays and approval workflow settings
Payroll types, salary structures and deductions
Form 16, salary certificates and monthly payroll report
items.benefit: Attendance, leave and payroll steps could become easier to complete and review, with records ready when approvals or reports are needed.
owner_to_confirm: Served by next_lms_erp (leave and attendance blocks in routes/api.php, payroll in routes/hrms.php); leave and attendance logic ported from hp_erp.
This is HR operations, not capability: confirm it belongs on the CCB card.
Leave Reports catalogue and saved-report lists are fixed lists in the screen, not live.
Payroll screens use older web routes; confirm payroll data is real and keep amounts off slides.
Attendance policy, regularization and request pages exist but are not in the menu; not shown.

items.name: Capability Intelligence
items.summary: Capability and competency libraries, role-to-competency framework, command dashboard, skills graph explorer and mentor skill matching.
items.problem: Without one shared skill language, roles, skills and required levels are described differently across teams, so gaps are hard to compare.
features: Library of job roles, tasks, knowledge, ability and behaviour
Competency library with clone, archive and CSV export
Map competencies to job roles with required levels
Dashboard filtered by department, job role and location
Explore skills and job roles as a graph

research.text: Explorer designed from a reference occupational ontology sourced from O*NET and SkillsFuture Singapore, per its source notes.

items.benefit: Roles, skills and required levels could become easier to describe in one shared language, so capability gaps could be easier to compare.
owner_to_confirm: Served by next_lms_erp (routes/competency_management.php, Services/Competency); ported from G2G, data is the school's own, not G2G's.
Dashboard assessment tiles are fixed at zero in code; hide them. Do not quote dashboard numbers.
Capability Explorer needs the Enterprise Brain graph; confirm it is reachable on the live site.
Mentor Skill Mapping says 'not set up yet' until the career crosswalk exists; suggestions are text similarity and HR confirms each match.
Ontology source (O*NET, SkillsFuture Singapore) comes from a code comment only; confirm credit wording.
Library content may be empty on live (8 Sep decision note); check before demo.
Cross-product reads of G2G data need a token that is not set up; not shown.

items.name: LMS
items.summary: Staff learning hub: course catalog, my learning player, course builder, session calendar, certificates and administration for training teams.
items.problem: Training courses, sessions and certificates are scattered, so it is hard to see who learned what and who is due.
features: Course catalog; assign courses to people, departments or roles
Course builder with modules, lessons and quizzes
Map each course to the capabilities it builds
My Learning player with notes, discussions and certificates
Training sessions calendar with registration
items.benefit: Training, sessions and certificates could become easier to organise, and staff learning could link more clearly to the capabilities schools need.
owner_to_confirm: Served by next_lms_erp (routes/g2g_lms.php); a port of the G2G LMS, separate from the K-12 student LMS.
Assessments screen calls route names the back end does not define (cycles, tests, mine); not shown.
'Write 5 with AI' needs an AI provider set up; screen note says questions tie to capabilities but the back end drops that link, so do not claim it.
Course outline and slide-deck AI routes exist with no screen; not shown.
Assignments dialog is labelled 'Assign Learning' in code; avoid that name on slides.
Learning Dashboard change-enrolment and cancel-enrolment calls use paths the back end lacks; only enrol works; test before demo.
Achievements widget returns nothing until its table exists; not shown.
